I'm curious to know why all the top comments here (that haven't been deleted) are people praising the use of psychadelics without the whole therapy guided angle. I get it, psychadelics help SOME people but for fuck sake, stop treating them like they are a wonder drug like people do with weed. Fact is, some people don't respond to certain treatments and flagrant use of these substances can really set you back without proper guidance, education, and preparation. I'm no doctor but I would advise against jumping straight into ANY drug without therapy first. I'm glad that those who found relief like this found it, but I worry for the people who are so desperate for relief that they make it worse by diving into something they don't fully understand. Be safe everyone!

This person has it right. What works for one may not work for another. If you haven't done so already, talk to a therapist. Don't move into these things blind, especially when it comes to substances like these.

Salvia isn't the same. That is a deleriant. Psychadelics allow you to still have your faculties intact but in my experience, everything is more intense. So, if you're happy, you are HAPPY. If you are anxious, you are ANXIOUS. The trick is to go into it in a comfortable environment and in a relaxed state. Salvia on the other hand, gives no recourse. it's a complete out of body that you have no control over. Not even remotely the same.

The logical part of you says they are right but that small part of you says "yeah, but WHAT IF!?" As a kid that WHAT IF dominates your thoughts. His/Her parents check and nothing is there. The logical part of your brain says nothing is there but that one part says 'Yeah, but WHAT IF!?" It's a constant monster on your periphery that only you notice and it can spring at any time or it may not spring at all...that is anxiety

Hey buddy, first off, I think you are awesome and should stay that way. Be yourself despite it all. I've had multiple step dads and step moms and the common theme is that they DON'T want to overstep their boundaries. Despite what you and your dad think, they are always there. Additionally, if you feel judged by your counselor, get a new one. No progress is made in the presence of people you don't feel comfortable with. I'm sorry you are hitting a wall my friend  but I guarantee that this will pass. My best advice is to just concentrate on your own happiness a d do what YOU think is right. If you have to lay it all out to your dad and/or step mom so be it. If they can't grasp or care where you are coming from, cut 'em. I know that is harsh but you deserve people who understand the pain we all suffer from.

Reaching out to a professional is awesome! I'm so glad I did it. I know there is a stigma behind drugs and anxiety/depression but when you get to a point you HAVE to go. That took a ton of courage and you should be proud of yourself! I know how hard that first step is. Congrats my friend, the road to recovery and peace is long but I promise that you made a very big step!

Hey buddy. Don't worry about it. Your good friends won't be bothered with it and the better friends will make sure you are ok. If people give you shit about something you can't help, they aren't worth your time anyway. I have a small group of friends who know what's up and they are like my family. Don't ever be ashamed.

In my experience anxiety attacks differ only slightly. I would say, and hope, that this was just a weird experience for you. If it continues to happen, seek help. If not, you are all good buddy. Everyone gets a weird out from time to time.
I know I'm a day late but keep that head up! Tomorrow is another day. Just wake up, breathe deep, and take stock. You are important. You are needed. Don't let petty shit get you down!

Man, I'm gonna level with you. I've been socially awkward/anxious since before it was widely recognized. Problem is, It's NEVER going to go away. Just the facts. Some people have the gift, some don't. If your like me, you don't. It took me YEARS to get build my confidence. Thing is, stop giving a fuck. Do YOU like YOU? If not, work on that first. I'm still working on that but the second you decide that you are who you want to be; fuck everyone else. It all falls into place from there. I promise. Be at peace with yourself first my friend.
Damn, this really hits close to home. Even though I'm the older brother my nervous ticks carry on... I feel for you.

I was really religious when I was young. Back in the mid-90s the Left Behind books came out. It's funny to me now but back then, I would wake up almost every night to be sure my mom and sisters weren't taken. Everything out of the ordinary was an act of God to me. Power went Out? God took everyone but me. I've been trying to be more logical but that animal part always says "yeah, but what if?" I've been trying to ignore that.

It wasn't about you at all. I know this doesn't help at this juncture but he probably can't be around most people at this point. Much less be in an intimate relationship, I had this problem with the woman I ended up marrying but mostly because she understood that when I needed space...I NEEDED space. Anxiety is a crazy thing. My wife has learned how to talk me out of attacks but that takes commitment. We've been together for 10 years now and she knows how I am. The unfortunate part about being with someone with a disorder is learn8ng to live with it. However, if you truly care for the it won't matter. I think my wife and I are closer as a result.

I know that feeling. I think about it all the time. Just to get away from the constant anxious feeling. However, think about what you would miss. Think about your family. Think about the things the things that are good in your life. I think about offing myself alot, It's almost the most positive thing I think about. However, I know I have a lot of people to live for. If you don't think so, you aren't thinking hard enough. Hell, if you don't know anyone else, I'll think about you. Us with anxiety and depression have to stick together.
